text:
Greetings desk staff,
Arrival checks came up this week, so just a quick note. The Companion Animal Travel Desk needs every check-in file tightened up before the rush starts again, because the handoff from booking to cabin review has been messy and we cannot afford more near misses. Please read each traveler note fully, flag any gap right away, and keep the updates moving so the safety coordinator can review them without having to chase details.

For Brightwater files, make sure the pet record matches the cabin limit and the carrier setup is clean before you confirm anything. <<FACT F032>> We have had a few calls where the paperwork looked fine at first glance, then the gate review found a mismatch and held everything up. If you see a case tied to Julian Yilmaz, Arjun Shah, or Phoebe, stay with it until the last detail is checked and the passenger gets a clear answer.

For Cloudrest trips, the cabin setting note has to be visible in the file, and the same goes for any feeding or comfort alerts that could affect the move. <<FACT F040>> If a note is missing, do not guess and do not push it through just to clear the queue. Send it back, mark what is missing, and keep the line of communication open so the next desk person can pick it up without confusion. We need calm, fast, and exact handling here, because even small errors can slow a pet at the airport and make a simple trip harder than it should be.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
